components.name: Primary Search Button

components.css: .ds-search-button { display:inline-flex; min-width:150px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px; padding:14px 20px; border:0; color:#fff; background:var(--accent,#e34b22); font:780 1rem system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-search-button:hover { background:var(--accent-dark,#a72d10); } .ds-search-button:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-search-button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--accent,#e34b22); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-search-button svg { width:20px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-width:2; }

components.name: Outline Example Button
components.description: A low-emphasis action used to load a sample query.
components.css: .ds-example-button { padding:9px 12px; border:1px solid var(--ink,#10251f); color:var(--ink,#10251f); background:transparent; font:720 1rem system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-example-button:hover { background:var(--paper,#f8faf8); } .ds-example-button:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-example-button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--accent,#e34b22); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Kit Query Field
components.description: The dominant input for remembered kit names and fragments.
components.css: .ds-query-field { display:block; padding:18px 20px 16px; background:var(--paper,#f8faf8); } .ds-query-field span { display:block; margin-bottom:7px; color:var(--ink-soft,#445a52); font:760 .72rem system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-query-field input { width:100%; padding:0; border:0; color:var(--ink,#10251f); background:transparent; font:700 2rem/1.1 "Barlow Condensed","Arial Narrow",sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.02em; } .ds-query-field input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--accent,#e34b22); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Filter Select
components.description: A compact paper-cell selector for grade, scale, and availability.
components.css: .ds-filter-field { display:block; padding:12px 14px; background:var(--paper,#f8faf8); } .ds-filter-field span { display:block; margin-bottom:7px; color:var(--ink-soft,#445a52); font:760 .72rem system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-filter-field select { width:100%; border:0; color:var(--ink,#10251f); background:transparent; font:650 1rem system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-filter-field select:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--accent,#e34b22); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Selected Candidate Row
components.description: A ranked canonical candidate with the active inspection mark.
components.css: .ds-result-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:42px minmax(0,1fr) minmax(116px,.35fr) 74px; width:100%; gap:15px; align-items:center; padding:15px 10px 15px 4px; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#9eaca6); color:var(--ink,#10251f); background:var(--selection-wash,#fff3ed); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--accent,#e34b22); text-align:left; cursor:pointer; } .ds-result-row:hover { background:var(--paper,#f8faf8); } .ds-result-row:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--accent,#e34b22); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-result-row strong { display:block; font:750 .98rem/1.25 "Barlow Condensed","Arial Narrow",sans-serif; } .ds-result-row small { display:block; margin-top:5px; color:var(--ink-soft,#445a52); font:.74rem system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-rank { color:var(--ink-soft,#445a52); font:760 1rem system-ui,sans-serif; text-align:center; } .ds-path { color:var(--ink-soft,#445a52); font:.72rem/1.35 system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-score { text-align:right; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-score strong { font:760 1.15rem system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-score small { margin:0; text-transform:uppercase; }

narrative.overview:
GundHere should feel like a precise work surface where a hobbyist compares box labels, catalog identities, and evidence—not like a generic analytics dashboard. Cool gray-green surfaces form the bench; dense ruled rows form the candidate rack; a warm paper sheet holds the selected kit's evidence. Ink green supplies authority, while safety orange behaves like a physical selection mark.

The system is compact, factual, and tactile. It favors one continuous scan path from lookup to ranked candidates to inspection detail. Expressiveness comes from condensed inventory typography, square marks, fine rules, tabular scores, and restrained industrial color rather than decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Cool measured work surfaces with a subtle 24px bench grid.
Condensed inventory-label typography paired with highly legible system text.
Safety orange reserved for action, focus, rejection, and active selection.
Ruled rows and paper sheets that keep ranking evidence visually inspectable.
Compact desktop density that collapses deliberately for narrow screens.

rules.name: The Safety-Mark Rule
rules.body: Orange must identify an action, focus target, active choice, or rejection; it is never a decorative fill.

rules.name: The Ink-on-Paper Rule
rules.body: Long-form and diagnostic text stays ink green on paper or the measured work surface; do not introduce pure black panels into the workspace.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use the condensed face for identity and hierarchy; use the system face for operation and evidence. Do not add a third typographic voice.

rules.name: The One Scan Path Rule
rules.body: Place query, retrieval summary, ranked candidates, and selected evidence in reading order; never make users jump between disconnected dashboards.

rules.name: The Paper-Lift Rule
rules.body: Elevation marks active work surfaces, not every container. Lists, summaries, and metadata remain ruled and flat.

rules.name: The Functional Curve Rule
rules.body: Curves communicate status, compact tags, or stamped scoring; they do not soften the main workbench structure.

dos: Do keep the interface anchored in the cool measured work surface, inspection paper, and green-black ink palette.
Do reserve safety orange for action, focus, selection, and rejection.
Do use tabular numerals and aligned columns wherever ranking evidence is compared.
Do preserve the 3px visible focus outline and reduced-motion behavior.
Do collapse secondary detail before shrinking primary labels beyond legibility.
donts: Don't turn the product into a rounded-card dashboard or distribute shadows across every region.
Don't use orange as ambient decoration or a large page background.
Don't add speculative badges, thresholds, prices, availability, or confidence claims.
Don't replace ruled rows with isolated tiles; the rack metaphor depends on continuous comparison.
Don't add ornamental typefaces, gradients, or glossy effects that break the inspection-bench character.
